underlines.text: Kitty was the only one who shed tears; but she did weep from vexation and envy

reference.text: Wholly inattentive to her sister’s feelings, Lydia flew about the house in restless ecstasy, calling for everyone’s congratulations, and laughing and talking with more violence than ever; whilst the luckless Kitty continued in the parlour repining at her fate in terms as unreasonable as her accent was peevish.

underlines.text: the clamorous happiness of Lydia herself in bidding farewell
